quest.title: Twice Upon a Gaze
quest.description: Having completed the qualifiers successfully, Linnea suggests going to Speranza to celebrate properly...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x700, Mora x62225, Hero's Wit x7, Mystic Enhancement Ore x14

talks.objective: Head to Speranza for a meal

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Ahem... May I take your order?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Turns out I'm treating a friend today, so... I'd like to order the finest dish in the house.

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Oh... I take it you're referring to our... secret menu?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: That's right. Tell the chef to sharpen his knife... I'm expecting surgical precision.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Is that a reference to something?

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Yeah, "The Hidden Hero." It's a novel my best friend Helka sent from Liyue. There's this chef, and he fights the bad guys with a kitchen knife! It's really cool.

dialogues.speaker: Mikko
dialogues.text: It's her favorite part of the book. She's always nagging Linnea to act it out with her.

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Psst! Linnea, do you think Chef Jurva could be a hero in disguise, too? He does chop vegetables super fast...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Ooh... I think it's definitely possible...

dialogues.speaker: Jurva
dialogues.text: Not a chance, I'm afraid. Evening, everyone. What can I get you?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Why don't you choose for us? I'm treating a friend today. We're celebrating our success in the qualifiers.

dialogues.speaker: Jurva
dialogues.text: Sure thing. I'll rustle up a few of my specialties, then. Won't be long!

dialogues.speaker: Borzyslaw
dialogues.text: Hello, I'm ready to order...

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Be right there!

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: I gotta go. Let's play again soon, Linnea!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You seem to get along really well with everyone here. Oh, that's right — didn't you say that this used to be your home?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Yes. After my parents departed, I came to live here with my friends in the Conch Gang.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Ah! I didn't mean... like that. They're still alive and well, they just don't live around here anymore.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Come to think of it, I haven't told you my story yet. I guess you'll have noticed the wings on my head by now? They're proof that I'm not human.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Paimon noticed those! Are you comfortable telling us some more?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Sure. Well, it's a story that starts a long, long time ago.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: When I was just a kid, my wings were barely noticeable. They looked just like two little cowlicks.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: No one suspected there was anything unusual about me at first. Not even Mom and Dad — they were too busy to notice.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: But I always had this strange feeling I couldn't explain... Like I knew that all these little ways I was different from my friends couldn't just be a coincidence.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Then, when I was a little bit older, I read this story in a book of folktales... It was about "changelings."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Changelings"? What are those?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: The story goes that some of the Snowland Fae will secretly switch their own child with a human baby, leaving their offspring to be raised by humans while taking the human child for themselves.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I know, right? The way the stories are written, it sounds like something parents make up to scare naughty kids.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: "If you don't behave, the fae will take you away and leave a better-behaved child in your place." It's the sort of thing that starts as a warning and evolves into folklore over time.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: So obviously, I didn't take it seriously at first... But then, as I grew older, I started exhibiting more and more fae-like traits.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I mean, just look at the crystals on my skin. No humans have those. It's a dead giveaway.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, you're really a changeling, huh? Did you tell your mom and dad?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Bear with me. I'm getting to that.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: At first, I wanted to hide it from them, but eventually, I plucked up the courage to tell them. I figured, even when we're scared and uncertain, it's important to face the truth head-on.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: They were stunned, of course. It took them a while to accept it, but after the truth had sunk in, Dad sat me down and told me they'd decided to head north and look for their child that was taken.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: They're really good people, though. Not only did they raise me for all those years, but they left me some money in case of emergencies.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: After that, I grew up with my friends in the Conch Gang. All of these kids are from broken homes, but everyone supports each other, and they still live life to the fullest.

response.speaker: Jurva
response.text: Food's ready. Talking about old times again?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Yeah, it just sorta came up in conversation... Whoa, what's all this? You've cooked up a real feast, Jurva!

response.speaker: Jurva
response.text: Well, you did say you were treating a friend. Besides, only the best for our old boss.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Old boss"? Linnea was your boss?

choices.text: So you were the head honcho of the Conch Gang?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Hey, what kind of a reaction is that?

response.speaker: Jurva
response.text: Hahaha, Linnea has been a fountain of knowledge ever since she was a kid. She always speaks with such authority. Everyone admired her so much that we picked her to be our boss.

response.speaker: Jurva
response.text: But the Conch Gang's only for children. Once you grow up, you have to leave, so now she's the "old boss."

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I've always found the logic behind that title to be a little flawed... I mean, what happens when the others grow up? Will I be the... "ex-old boss"? Surely, it won't be long before I'm the "previous former ex-ex-old boss"...

response.speaker: Jurva
response.text: We'll all be long gone from the Conch Gang by that point. As far as we're concerned, there's only one person that we'll ever think of as our "old boss," and that's you.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Aww, that's really touching...

response.speaker: Jurva
response.text: Well, if it means that much, maybe you could leave a 2,000 Mora tip. Much appreciated. Mikko's birthday is coming up, so we're pooling our money to get him some new clothes.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Sure thing! I'll go one better and give you 3,000. But just this once, alright? I have my own stuff to save for.

response.speaker: Maisie
response.text: Ooh, what are you saving up for, Linnea?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Hehe, I have big plans! I wanna buy a huge ship for scientific research, then take my friends on a voyage of discovery to explore all the mysteries of the world!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I wanna sail to all the other nations... hear the heartbeat of the jungle, the whispers of the wind, the echoes of the mountains... And one day, when I'm too old for all that, I'll combine everything I've learned into a great illustrated atlas of nature.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Of course, there are other questions I hope to get answers to along the way. Like, what exactly Lumi is, and... where my birth parents are.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Have you tried to find them before?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Well... When I was much younger, I used to hear these strange lullabies as I was drifting off to sleep.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: "Go, child of the fae."

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: "Make your way to the villages and towns and seek kinship with the humans."

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: "The world of the fae is rife with a sorrow you do not understand."

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: They were sung in the tongue of the fae by kind, warm voices. I can't explain why, but... somehow, I knew that they didn't want me chasing after my origins.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Still, I did visit the tundra once when I was a little older to see if I could find out anything about them. But just being there made me feel uncomfortable... Every instinct was telling me to leave.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: It's odd — that place is supposed to be my home, but it feels like I'm unwelcome there. Could it simply be because I'm a bird fae, so I prefer a warmer climate...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ooh... I think it's definitely possible...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Hmm... Something tells me there's gotta be more to it than that. The less I know about something, the more curious I am. One day, I'm gonna get to the bottom of it.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: But enough about that. We're supposed to be celebrating our victories! Cheers!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Cheers!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cheers! Paimon can't wait to dig in!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I'm stuffed. How about you guys?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, Paimon's fit to burst...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Let's see... It's a little early to hit the hay. How about we get Aguara and Lumi to try a little sparring practice? The opponents are only gonna get tougher from here.

response.speaker: Lumi
response.text: Ya-ho!

response.speaker: Aguara
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: They seem to like that idea.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Hehe, then what are we waiting for? Let's go!

choices.text: Please excuse my ignorance, Don Linnea...

talks.objective: Have a training match with Linnea

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: ...They're very evenly matched.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It's strange. When I was battling you, I couldn't seem to get into the zone. I had no way to predict your next move.

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-ho?

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Hey, I'm curious — why does Aguara have a ribbon tied around his tail? And how did you two meet, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that's a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You briefly sum up the events from "Lost in the Woods" and how you came to be friends with Aguara.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: What an incredible adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: ...Someday, I wanna go on an adventure of my own, show Lumi every corner of the world. There's gotta be countless stories out there waiting to be told.

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-ho!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: You're excited too, huh, Lumi?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: But most importantly, we have to figure out who you are and where you came from. Then, we can track down others just like you.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Maybe then, you won't feel lonely anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Linnea...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Ah! It's about time we all got some rest. Good training session, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I'll see you at the arena tomorrow! Oh, we'll have to draw lots again, won't we? Hopefully we don't end up facing each other this early in the competition...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Wait, no! Agh! Forget I said it! I should go before I jinx it!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Lumi!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See you tomorrow! Thanks for dinner!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: You're welcome. Byeee!

dialogues.speaker: Panu
dialogues.text: Bleurgh! Waiter! Come here and taste this Wildberry Trail, then look me in the eye and tell me it's fit for human consumption!

dialogues.speaker: Panu
dialogues.text: It's much too sour and has a bitter aftertaste! I want my money back!

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Please don't shout. I assure you, the berries we use are of the highest quality — "bitter" is out of the question.

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: I think you've had too much to drink. Time to settle up and leave.

dialogues.speaker: Panu
dialogues.text: Too much to drink!? I'm perfectly sober, thank you! Now, you'd better give me this meal on the house, otherwise—

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: ...Otherwise what?

dialogues.speaker: Panu
dialogues.text: Huh? Who the heck are you?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, I'll tell you who the heck I am. The name's Arataki "Thanks-for-Waiting, Mucho-Apreciado" Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Panu
dialogues.text: Uhh... an oni... it's an oni!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Nice work, Itto. Keep this up, and we might just have to double your bonus at the end of the month.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Heh, don't you worry about a thing. As long as Itto's around, consider this establishment protected.

talks.objective: Return to The Flagship to rest

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The person in the room next door paces around restlessly all night. Despite the annoying pitter-patter of footsteps, you manage to drift off to sleep...

talks.objective: Draw lots for the elimination round

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see, your next opponent is... Haniyyah. Huh, that name sounds familiar...

choices.text: We met her at the Beast Tamers Tournament in Sumeru...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohhh, yeah! Paimon remembers now! She's been looking after our Fungi friends this whole time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who do you think she's gonna partner up with for the competition?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, let's go say hello!

choices.text: She was the runner-up in the Nilotpala Cup.

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: Welcome one and all! The Round of 16 is about to begin.

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: #Our contestants for this match are: {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} partner Aguara, versus Haniyyah and her partner, Fluffy the Flower King!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Hey, Golden Comet and Silver Companion! Good to see you again. This'll be our first proper rematch since the Nilotpala Cup...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I brought my old Sumpter Beast with me this time. Looks like you're partnering with a new companion too... Let's see who wins this time around!

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Aguara are the winners!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Ah, what a shame... We were so close!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Even with a new partner, you're still as tough as they come... *sigh* This was some bad luck, running into you so early in the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Well, since you defeated me, you'd better go all the way like in the Nilotpala Cup. I can handle losing — but only to a champion! So you go show them who's boss!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I won't let you down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! We're through to the quarter-finals! Let's go see who our next opponent is.

talks.objective: Draw lots for the second elimination round

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon take a look — next up is... Mualani?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, so we have to fight that big koholasaur next? Aguara, we're counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Rawr...

choices.text: Uh... You just need to believe in yourself!

response.speaker: Aguara
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Paimon noticed something when we were drawing lots. Most of the contestants have given their animal companion a cool title. Shall we come up with one for Aguara, too?

response.speaker: Aguara
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Aguara seems to like it! Awesome! Okay, let's head to the next match!

response.speaker: Aguara
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Aguara
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Aguara
response.text: Rawr!

choices.text: Don't worry. Just do your best.

talks.objective: Participate in the second elimination round
Participate in the second elimination round

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: Are you ready to ruuumble? Ladies and gentlemen, it's time for the quarterfinals!

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: After a fierce competition so far, we're left with the creme de la creme of the contestants. But who among them will advance to the semifinals? There's only one way to find out!

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: #Joining us to kick this round off, we have... {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} partner Aguara, versus Mualani and her partner Mamala!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: How're you feeling today, Mamala?

dialogues.speaker: Mamala
dialogues.text: Raargh!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That's the spirit! Now, let's get out there and show these Nod-Krai folks what the People of the Springs are all about!

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: #Mamala has lost the strength to fight on — {NICKNAME} and Aguara are the winners!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Seriously? There's no way I just lost...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Gotta hand it to you, Aguara... You are seriously strong for your age! That was incredible!

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Mamala
dialogues.text: Aww...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hey, you're strong too, Mamala. That one was on me — I made too many bad calls. I'm sorry!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Keep it up, Aguara! I wanna see you take down even more opponents. You were the best little saurian out there today!

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I'll leave you guys to it. Cheer up, Mamala! How about I take you for a tasty treat, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Mamala
dialogues.text: Awoo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that was a nail-biting match... Paimon's heart's still racing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, Linnea will have finished her match by now, too, right? Let's go see how she did!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Linnea!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is your match over already?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It sure is. Wanna take a guess who won?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Judging by the smile on your face, Paimon's pretty sure it was you.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Correct. I was about to go watch the other matches. Care to join me?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: The next one's a pretty big deal. Someone called Celaeno versus the reigning champion, Jahoda.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, we have to watch that! Jahoda's a friend of ours, so we should be there to cheer her on.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Perfect. Well, stick around — it should be starting soon.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: What the... Celaeno's companion is a Radiant Bladehorn!? Those things are extremely hostile... How did she manage to tame it?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Technically speaking, Radiant Bladehorns are classed as monsters... but they are beasts of the wild, and they're not exactly uncommon. It's not against the rules, but still... it's gonna be a really hard one to beat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go for it, Jahoda! You got this!
Ignorance really is bliss. But it won't last forever...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (So, Celaeno's her name. She was the one watching Linnea's last match, and there was something strangely hostile about her demeanor...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (But Linnea doesn't seem to know who she is. She talked about her as if she's just another contestant.)

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Do you think speed alone will stop me from catching you?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: How about you run around and find out!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Reed Miller XIII, run that thing ragged and then go in for the kill!

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Behind you on the right.

dialogues.speaker: Haemus
dialogues.text: Raargh!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Reed!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Her reaction time is incredible! It's almost as if...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: She can read her opponent's mind!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Dodge left, Lumi!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Thanks, that means a lot! Yeah, I think we performed pretty well out there. Not just Lumi — I was really in the zone today.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I dunno how to explain it, but... Sometimes, it feels like I can predict my opponent's next move. I know exactly what to do before I've even had the time to think.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Linnea said something similar after her first match. Could it be a coincidence?)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Keep it together, Reed. Jump!

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: He's trying to jump on your back, Haemus. Don't give him the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Use your wind blades to slow him down.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: He's too powerful! We've gotta go for a knockout blow!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Charge your lightning, Reed, then blast him with all you've got!

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Deflect it back, Haemus.

dialogues.speaker: Haemus
dialogues.text: Raargh!

dialogues.speaker: Reed Miller XIII
dialogues.text: Awoo...

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Tch... That was close. But the outcome is all that matters.

dialogues.speaker: Alzbeta
dialogues.text: Reed Miller XIII has lost the strength to fight on — Celaeno and Haemus are the winners!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Those wings...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: W—Wait! Who are you? And why do you...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Why you have... the same...

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: I've been through this moment so many times in my head... Imagining you sharing the same pain I feel.

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: I thought it would bring me joy, but I guess not... You're better off with the life you have, Linnea. The less you know, the better.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Argh... My head... Don't go! Wait, I... I...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Linnea!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What happened? Why did Linnea faint?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We gotta find her somewhere to lie down. Quick, hurry!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: What happened? Uh, uhhh... I'll go get Lauma!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: She's breathing normally — no obstruction of the airways. She just needs a little peace and quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... That's a relief! Thanks, Lauma.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: My pleasure. If she has any more trouble, just let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will do!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Linnea... Please wake up soon...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Good morning! ...Huh? Where am I?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Lumi! Lumi! How strange — where could she be?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (I wonder how long I was out for... Well, I'd better take a look outside.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Did it work...?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Guess not... Huh? Is Dream-Me writing a diary?)

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "My Adventurers' Guild salary alone will never be enough to finance a research vessel. It seems my only option is to take up adventuring full-time."

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (A research vessel? Looks like Dream-Me is working hard toward my goal... But the cost is just astronomical. It could take a whole lifetime to save up for.)

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "Day 1: Got beaten up by monsters."

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "Day 5: Ran for my life with Lumi. Turns out I'm getting faster!"

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "Day 20: Asked a merchant about prices. Ships cost a fortune! But I can worry about that later. Right now, it's time for a proper meal — I'm starving."

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "Day 72: Found a huge abandoned treasure chest. Hehe, finders keepers!"

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "Happy Adventure Anniversary to me! One year in... and still nowhere near rich enough to afford a ship."

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "Almost got scammed! Note to self — secondhand ships aren't to be trusted. Good job I was wary and checked it over thoroughly before committing. You really do get what you pay for."

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "Finally beat that pesky thing. Hoping the materials I gathered recently will fetch a good price..."

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (The diary ends here. Hold on, is this..?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (A deed for the purchase of a large ship, and I've signed it! Could it be...?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (...A dream come true.)

talks.objective: Enter the depths of the dream

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Lumi! There you are. I've been looking all over for you.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Come on, say something. Why do you look so anxious? Uh...)

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: Looks like our contestants and their partners are in position.

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: On the one side, we have Linnea and her partner Lumi, and on the other side, we have Celaeno and her partner Haemus! Buckle up folks — the semi-finals are about to begin!

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-ho!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Wait, how is it the semifinals already!? Also, how did I even get here...? I don't remember a thing!)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (...Oh. I get it. I'm still dreaming.)

dialogues.speaker: Mikko
dialogues.text: You can do it, old boss!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Even if this is a dream, I can't let my supporters down. I'm gonna give this my all!)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (We're up, Lumi! Let's show them what we've got!)

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-ho...

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: What a spectacular duel! But Lumi has lost the strength to fight on... Meaning, Celaeno and Haemus have earned their place in the final!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Huh? What's going on? They're saying I lost already?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (This dream sucks! I wanna wake up, right now.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Hmm, I've heard that if you try really hard to open your eyes, you can force yourself awake. Nnngh!)

talks.objective: Enter the depths of the dream
Enter the depths of the dream

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Lemme check the chart. Next stop, Guyun Stone Forest... That place is steeped in myths and stories. I've only ever seen it in picture books.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (From there, it's on to Dragonspine... Wow, a snow-capped mountain! I've always wanted to visit, but never dared to.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (What's this? ...Clearwater Jade? Pretty sure this can only be found in Chenyu Vale... It's so beautiful.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (It looks like this ship has sailed to many places already. Makes sense — as soon as I buy my research vessel, I'll be off and away to voyage non-stop.)

dialogues.speaker: Kowalska
dialogues.text: Linnea...

dialogues.speaker: Kowalska
dialogues.text: You've been really down the last couple of days. What's up? You're not seasick, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Kowalska
dialogues.text: I've left your lunch by the door. Make sure to get some good rest once you've eaten.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Coming...)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Hmm... Where am I now...?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (I feel so sore... and tired. Wait, but I thought I was dreaming? Why do I feel like this?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Is this some sort of lucid dream...? Whatever, I'd better take a look outside.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Clearwater Jade... Didn't I see this on the ship just now? Why is it in pieces...)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (And these books... How did they end up in this cave?)

talks.objective: Investigate the source of the sound

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Lumi... Why do you look so sad?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Hey, hey, don't be scared. I'm right here by your side.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Wh—What happened? I thought I was on the ship...)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (I—Is this... The Golden Beagle...?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (B—But why...)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (I—It's just a dream though... right? Come on, get a grip, Linnea. It's not real. None of this is real...)

talks.objective: Enter the depths of the dream

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "It's been many long years since the Golden Beagle sank."

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (The diary again... How long is this terrible dream going to last?)

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "I'd love to say I'm over it now, but the truth is it still gets me down sometimes. It's like there's a heavy stone that's blocking up my heart, constantly weighing me down."

dialogues.speaker: Diary
dialogues.text: "Maybe a walk in the courtyard will take my mind off things. Besides, my sister should be here soon. I can wait for her outside."
Linnea!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Huh? That voice sounds familiar...)

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Over here. Did you get my letter, Linnea?

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: I'm so sorry to be the bearer of bad news. Come back to the tundra with me, so we can be with Mom and Dad one last time.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Celaeno? She's my sister!?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Mom and Dad? One last time?)

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: This is the natural circle of life. We don't live that much longer than humans — this day was always going to come.

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: I... I can't pretend I'm not sad.

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: But at the same time... I wonder how an ordinary person would react to hearing this news? At the very least, they wouldn't have to endure this horrid feeling of having tears they're unable to shed.

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: After all... we've already seen how all of this would unfold, long before it ever came to pass.

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Remember? When you passed out during that competition? You saw it all as you lay there unconscious. <color=#37FFFF>At the time, you thought it was just a dream.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (What is she talking about...?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (No.... No, no, no... This can't be true...)

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: I understand how you feel. One moment, you're gazing into the future from the past, the next, you're there, looking back at where it all began... When these two perspectives collide, how can the journey not feel like a dream?

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Time flies. One day, we too will grow old. Is it even possible to live a life without regrets?

dialogues.speaker: Blurry Words
dialogues.text: "A long, long time ago, my friends and I talked about our dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Blurry Words
dialogues.text: "Mine was to buy a research vessel and explore the mysteries of the world. Then, when too old for a life of adventure, I'd combine everything I'd learned into an illustrated atlas of nature."

dialogues.speaker: Blurry Words
dialogues.text: "My entire life is recorded in these pages. Maybe one day, a long, long time from now, someone will open them and see that there are sections on the formation and evolution of certain creatures and environments that remain blank."

dialogues.speaker: Blurry Words
dialogues.text: "Whoever you are, I entrust the task of filling those blank pages to you. The end of my time grows near, and I can no longer travel very far."

talks.objective: Walk towards the end of everything

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (This feels like an illusion, yet at the same time, so real...)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (The end of life... So this is what death feels like.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (I still feel some faint sensations in my stiffening body, but I... I can't so much as move a finger. As the warmth flows out of me, I feel no pain, just the emptiness that remains after everything else has slipped away...)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (So it wasn't a dream after all... It's all...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hit it head-on!

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Wooraarr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A—Are you sure that's a good idea? A head-on collision between Aguara and a Sumpter Beast?

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: ...Look at that, right into orbit. Nice work, Fluffy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aguara!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aguara, dodge!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Huh? Fluffy! Wake up!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Fluffy...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: You're even tougher than last time!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: But you know what? Sumpter Beasts are renowned for their endurance. It's their refusal to give up that allows them to traverse huge rainforests and deserts, one step at a time.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: And when they charge full speed... Haha, they kick up enough dust to blot out the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Send 'em flying, Fluffy the Flower King!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Watch out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jump onto its back!

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: R—Rawr...!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Ugh... Looks like this isn't gonna work.

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: Contestants, please have your animal companions return to the arena immediately, or you'll both be disqualified!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Oh no! Come back, Fluffy!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Taking it head-on, huh? You shoulda run!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Sorry, but in terms of brute strength, a young tepetlisaur is no match for an adult koholasaur.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Don't try to be a hero next time!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I—I can't believe it... My glorious journey ended at the first step...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's your own fault for not reading the rules...

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ushi, Crimson Staff... Are you guys tryin' to cheer me up? Well, don't you worry! We'll come back stronger than ever next time, and I'll lead us to a glorious victory, fair and square!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Anyway, seeing as we came all this way, I think a little sightseeing is in order! Hahaha, let's go get ourselves a taste of Krod-Krai culture!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously? Again, it's "Nod-Krai"!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you actually have any Mora left?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Uhhh... Well...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ahem... Hey, Lavender Melon! I've got a little, uh, proposition for ya—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way! If you want Mora, go earn it like everyone else!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Pffft, fine, don't lend me anything then! Watch me, I'll figure something out. This is a small pond — and Arataki Itto is the biggest fish around!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Watch out!

dialogues.speaker: Mamala
dialogues.text: Awoo?

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: You took advantage of Mamala's blind spot... Not bad!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Saw that one coming a mile away!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Tepetlisaurs might have the advantage on land, but it's a different story in the water.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Mamala, finish 'em off!

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Awoo...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: What a tough cookie! I thought this'd be way easier... Your little saurian doesn't play around!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Alright, get up close and let's settle this!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Jump, Mamala! Get out of the water!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (From what I remember, Mamala's left eye is covered by an eyepatch. That might be an opening...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... Let's head back to The Flagship and get some sleep. Paimon's eyes are starting to droop!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Morning... Ah! Is that the time!? The draw's about to start! Come on, we gotta get moving!
